text.p: Investors subscribed for 1,873,460 shares in the 320,000-share open tranche of the initial public offering of Polish construction firm Energoaparatura SA, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.

The firm said orders were reduced by 82.5 percent in the open tranche, where 2,508 investors took shares, and 68.9 percent in a closed employee tranche of 20,000 shares, where 344 investors subcribed for 64,395 shares.
Energoaparatura has said it seeks a listing on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse in late February.
Before the issue the firm had 1.8 million shares, with largest shareholder, the Polish Private Equity Fund I, holding 21 percent.
The Polish Private Equity Fund II held 20.4 percent, the Polish-American Enterprise Fund 18.6 percent and Polish Development Bank (PBR) 15 percent.
